content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on § 22.1.

- **Issue:** § 22.1 allowed Vendor to audit us "at any time without notice" with remote access to our systems and records — walk-away territory on frequency, notice and system access, and it conflicted with § 22.2 (which already bars direct system access and puts cost on Vendor absent a >5% underpayment) and § 22.3.
- **Redline (preferred, validated):** § 22.1 now permits one audit per twelve-month period, on 30 days' prior written notice, during business hours, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, off-site where practicable, limited to usage-relevant records, with no remote or direct system access. §§ 22.2–22.3 left untouched as already compliant.
